Arbetsbeskrivning

FTZ | Rørup, Denmark

Join FTZ and help develop our growing Heavy Commercial Vehicles business
FTZ is looking for a Product Manager to strengthen our expanding Commercial Vehicle Division in Denmark. In this role, you will work with product groups within Heavy Commercial Vehicles, including trucks, trailers and buses, and contribute to developing an attractive and competitive product offering for the Danish aftermarket.

We are looking for someone with a strong understanding of commercial vehicles and their components, combined with an interest in product management and commercial development. Whether your background is in product management, spare parts, technical sales or workshop operations, your industry knowledge and motivation could make you the right person for this opportunity.

You will join a growing business area where you can make a real impact, working closely with experienced colleagues both locally and across the MEKO Group.

Your responsibilities

As Product Manager at FTZ, you will work within MEKO's Commercial Vehicle Division, supporting the development and management of several product groups within Heavy Commercial Vehicles.
Based on sales and profitability objectives, you will collaborate with colleagues to ensure that the right product range, competitive pricing and accurate product information are in place, while maintaining close dialogue with suppliers and internal stakeholders.

Your responsibilities will include:

•	Identifying, initiating and supporting projects for the launch of new products.
•	Preparing request-for-quotation material and product specifications for sourcing, and evaluating products in cooperation with colleagues across MEKO countries.
•	Managing product phase-in and phase-out activities.
•	Maintaining and administering product information in catalogues and PIM systems.
•	Monitoring competitors and supporting pricing activities.
•	Following up on product assortments, price levels, product performance and relevant actions related to obsolescence, returns and assortment changes.
•	Acting as a product expert within your areas and supporting the sales organization with technical knowledge.
•	Contributing to the development of an attractive and competitive product offering for customers.

This is a broad, hands-on role combining operational product management with opportunities to contribute to commercial development. You will have regular contact with suppliers, sales teams, product colleagues and logistics functions.

You will work closely with the local Head of Commercial Vehicles and the Group Category Manager, who provides strategic category direction and support. The position does not include personnel management.


Din Profil

Your profile

Your understanding of Heavy Commercial Vehicles and their components is the most important qualification for this position.

We are looking for someone with relevant experience from trucks, trailers, buses or a closely related heavy-duty industry. You may currently work in product management, spare parts, technical sales, workshop operations, parts distribution or a similar role. Experience from agricultural machinery, construction equipment or other heavy-duty applications may also be relevant.

To succeed in the role, we believe you have:

•	Solid practical knowledge of commercial vehicles, their components and applications.
•	Relevant experience from heavy commercial vehicles (truck, trailer, bus) or comparable heavy-duty applications – e.g. from workshop, spare parts, technical sales or product work 
•	Good computer literacy and the willingness to work extensively with digital product information and systems.
•	A structured, service-minded and proactive approach to your work.
•	An interest in product development, assortment management and commercial opportunities.
•	Good communication skills and the ability to collaborate across teams and countries.
•	Fluency in English, both spoken and written.

The following qualifications are considered advantages rather than requirements:

•	Previous experience as a Product Manager, Product Specialist or Category Manager.
•	Experience with Excel, ERP systems such as AX or Enterprise, or Product Information Management (PIM).
•	Strong analytical skills and experience working with product or sales data.
•	Danish or other Nordic language skills.
•	Post-secondary technical education.

What matters is your technical understanding, your motivation and your willingness to develop your product management capabilities.


Om företaget

About FTZ

FTZ is one of Denmark's leading automotive aftermarket distributors, supplying spare parts, tools and solutions to professional workshops and automotive businesses.

As part of the MEKO Group, FTZ combines its strong position in Denmark with the expertise, purchasing capabilities and international network of one of Northern Europe's leading automotive aftermarket groups.

The Commercial Vehicle Division is a growing business area focused on trucks, trailers and other heavy-duty applications. You will join an organization with strong technical and commercial competence, close cooperation across countries and opportunities to contribute to the continued expansion of the business.

MEKO operates across eight European countries through established brands, including FTZ, Mekonomen and MECA. The Group drives development in digitalization, logistics and sustainable mobility solutions, with a vision to enable mobility today, tomorrow and in the future.

Location: The preferred base is FTZ's headquarters in Rørup, Denmark. Candidates living in Southern Sweden are also welcome to apply. The role requires regular on-site presence in Rørup, especially during the initial onboarding period. The practical setup will be discussed with the selected candidate.

In this recruitment, FTZ Denmark is partnering with Autorekrytering. If you have any questions regarding the position or the recruitment process, please feel free to contact Clemens Döring, Clemens.doring@autorekrytering.se.

You are part of the marketing leadership team, with a group-level mandate across both Mips and Koroyd. Your mission is to build a unified digital strategy that bridges the gap between B2B ingredient branding and B2C consumer pull.
What you will do 
Set the digital strategy and roadmap. Define the multi-year strategy, anchored in company strategy and the commercial plan, and translate business objectives into priorities, targets and a prioritized portfolio of initiatives.
Own the digital ecosystem for Mips and Koroyd. Paid media, website, social media, SEO, ambassador and influencer marketing, and e-commerce campaigns. Set targets and KPIs per channel and decide on reallocation across the mix, while each brand keeps its own distinct presence and tone of voice.
Own the digital investment. Be responsible for the total digital investment across media, platforms, technology, agencies and resources. Set business cases and return requirements, propose the annual budget and own in-year reallocation, with a clear cost-efficiency and ROI focus.
Lead data, marketing technology and AI. Own the marketing technology stack and the data, measurement and attribution model behind all reporting and optimization. Set the AI agenda across search and generative engine optimization, AI-assisted shopping and product discovery across our digital ecosystem, and AI-driven content and campaign production.
Set governance and manage risk. Establish decision rights, standards and quality gates, and own digital risk and compliance together with Legal, including privacy, consent, accessibility and platform policy.
Build the team and the operating model. Lead a team of three digital specialists (analytics and performance, website and social media), design one digital operating model for the group, secure the right competence in the digital team and build digital capability across the wider business.
Represent digital at the top. Present performance, risks and investment cases to the executive team and the Board together with the Head of Marketing, and own senior relationships with agencies, platform partners and technology vendors, including negotiating master agreements. 

What success looks like in your first 12 to 18 months 
One digital strategy and roadmap for Mips and Koroyd, agreed with leadership.
A common operating model with shared platforms, standards, agencies and ways of working, and a distinct digital presence for each brand.
A highly functional digital team with the right competence for the opreating model.
A measurement and attribution model and a clear plan for the marketing technology stack.
An AI roadmap with concrete use cases, guardrails and productivity targets across search, commercial and production.
A digital investment portfolio with business cases and return requirements, built into the next annual planning cycle.

Who you are
You have led digital at scale in a multi-brand or international environment, with a track record of results and of delivering digital transformation.
You have line management experience and have developed specialist teams.
You have owned digital investment decisions: business cases, return requirements and trade-offs across channels, markets and technology.
You understand the full digital ecosystem, marketing technology and data, and have a practical view of how AI is changing search, e-commerce and content production.
You are commercially minded and credible with executives, agencies and vendors, and comfortable negotiating.
You set direction and prioritize, and you build trust across brands and teams.
You are fluent in English. Swedish is a strong advantage.

Do you want to help customers succeed with some of the world's most advanced energy technologies while building long-term relationships that create real value?

Customer Training is a key part of every HVDC Service project. It enables our customers to safely operate, maintain, and further develop their HVDC systems for decades to come. As Customer Training Manager, you will play a vital role in turning complex technical knowledge into practical learning experiences that support our customers throughout the lifecycle of their assets.

In this role, you will own and coordinate the customer training deliverable from tender/Quotation phase through project execution and final handover. You will work closely with customers, project teams, technical experts, trainers, suppliers, and service organizations around the world to ensure successful training delivery.

You will be part of the HVDC Service Project Support organization, a diverse and collaborative team where planning, documentation, field operations, and training experts work together to support customers globally. We believe in teamwork, knowledge sharing, continuous improvement, and empowering each other to succeed.

What makes this role unique is the opportunity to follow customer training throughout the entire customer journey. Within HVDC Service, you will contribute to projects that extend the life, performance, and reliability of critical energy infrastructure, helping customers maximize the value of their HVDC investments long after the initial project delivery.
We are interested in learning more about you and what you can contribute with, so please apply even if you don't meet every requirement.
How you'll make an impact

Lead and coordinate customer training activities throughout the HVDC Service project lifecycle.
Translate customer requirements and technical specifications into training strategies, concepts, schedules, budgets, and deliverables.
Represent Customer Training in tenders and projects by building an understanding of scope, division of work, customer expectations, risks, budgets, quality requirements, and delivery timelines.
Work closely with technical experts and trainers to develop and deliver engaging classroom, virtual, and digital learning experiences.
Coordinate customers, project teams, trainers, and suppliers to ensure successful and timely training delivery.
Manage training budgets, cost calculations, risks, and follow-up activities throughout project execution.
Ensure training documentation, materials, equipment, simulators, and customized devices are available and aligned with project requirements.
Monitor progress, commitments, documentation, quality, and customer satisfaction throughout the delivery.
Drive continuous improvement of customer training processes, digital learning solutions, and ways of working.
Transform customer and trainer feedback into actions that further enhance our training offerings and customer experence.

Your background

Experience in project management, coordination, training, tendering, or customer-facing project delivery environments.
Strong planning, communication, and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities.
A structured and proactive approach with strong problem-solving capabilities.
Customer-focused mindset with a genuine interest in building relationships and creating value.
Technical curiosity and willingness to learn about HVDC technology and energy systems.
Leadership qualities combined with the ability to work collaboratively in global teams.
Excellent English communication skills, written and spoken. Swedish is beneficial, and additional languages are an advantage.

Why join HVDC Service?

At HVDC Service, you become part of an organization that supports some of the world's most important energy assets throughout their operational lifetime. You will work in an international environment where experienced specialists, project teams, and customers collaborate to improve reliability, availability, and performance of HVDC systems across the globe.
This role offers a unique combination of:
Customer interaction and relationship building.
Project and stakeholder management.
Training and knowledge transfer.
Commercial and tender work.
Opportunities to influence and improve global ways of working.

Most importantly, you will see the direct impact of your work by helping customers develop the competence needed to safely operate and maintain critical energy infrastructure.

We're looking for an HR Business Partner to join our team in Landskrona. In this role, you'll partner closely with managers and employees, providing HR support across the employee lifecycle.
This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys working close to the business, building strong relationships, and making a tangible impact on employee engagement, workplace culture, and business performance. The role offers a broad HR scope, covering everything from manager assistance and employee relations to recruitment, leadership development, Health & Safety, and annual HR processes. You'll work in an international environment while being part of a partnership-focused HR team supporting the Landskrona site.
 
What you would do as our HR Business Partner
As HR Business Partner, you will act as a dependable advisor to managers and employees across designated parts of the Landskrona site. You will facilitate day-to-day people matters, drive key HR processes, ensure compliance with Swedish labor legislation, and contribute to creating a positive, safe, and engaging workplace. You will report to the HR Director for the Landskrona site and work closely with managers, employees, HR colleagues, and other stakeholders across the organization.
 
Key Responsibilities
Act as a reliable advisor to managers, providing guidance on leadership, organizational development, employee relations, and Swedish labour law, including MBL consultations with trade unions.
Drive leadership and talent development initiatives while encouraging employee engagement, organizational effectiveness, and a positive workplace culture.
Lead and coordinate annual HR processes, including salary reviews, performance management, employee surveys, and related people initiatives.
Facilitate recruitment activities in close contact with the Talent Acquisition team, also contribute to securing and developing organizational capability.
Oversee Health & Safety, rehabilitation, HR policies, compliance and people processes to ensure a safe, compliant, and well-functioning workplace.

 
The skills and experience you need
We are looking for someone who has:
 
Minimum 5 years of experience in HR Business Partner, HR Generalist, or similar broad HR role, with a proven ability to support managers and drive people-related initiatives.
Solid knowledge of Swedish labour law combined with hands-on experience in employee relations, trade union consultations (MBL) and guiding organizational change.
Experience leading core HR processes such as salary reviews, performance management, employee surveys, and broader people and culture initiatives.
Strong insight into Health & Safety, rehabilitation processes and HR compliance, ideally gained within a complex organizational environment.
Experience working in international matrix organizations, backed by strong communication skills in both Swedish and English, proficiency in HR systems (preferably SAP SuccessFactors), and the ability to build relationships across all levels of the business.

 
We believe you're a collaborative and business-oriented HR professional who enjoys building trusted relationships and assisting managers in a fast-paced and evolving organization. Collaborate with internal stakeholders, EMEIA Category Managers and other divisions, and step in for colleagues when needed.

Holds a university degree in business, engineering or a related field; training or education in procurement or logistics is a strong advantage.

Possesses knowledge of ISO 9001, 14001, 18001 and 27001 standards and how they apply to supplier decisions.

You are independent and structured, able to plan and prioritise your own work, and you take ownership of your decisions and the risks that come with them. Building good relationships comes naturally to you, and you enjoy working with people across functions, divisions and countries. What really drives our growth, and what should we do next? Help us find out.
Why does a customer turn down an offer that would save them money? Which product should we launch next? In what marketing channel should we scale spend? You’ll ask the right questions, find the answers, put a number on them and make sure we act.
If you want your analysis to shape where we grow, we should talk.
The foundation is built. Now it needs to grow.
Anyfin helps people pay less for the loans they already have. We only make an offer if we can lower someone's total cost. Since 2017 we've helped people across Sweden, Finland and Germany take back control of their finances. We're profitable, we have a banking licence that lets us operate across the EU, and we're getting ready to launch new products and enter new markets. Our ambition is to be a pan-European company by 2030.
Every one of those steps raises a question: which product, which market, which change to the customer journey makes the biggest difference? Growing well depends on answering them properly.
The team is small and intentionally so. We'd rather have fewer people who care about doing things properly and move fast because they trust each other. If you join, you won't disappear into a big org. You'll shape what we build and where we go next.
The actual job
You'll join our Commercial team within Growth and work across both business and product. One week you're digging into why customers drop off in the app. Next you're building the case for a new product or market.
You'll own the funnel. That covers web and app, from first visit to payout. You'll find where and why customers drop off, put a number on the opportunity and recommend what to fix first.
You'll come up with new bets. These could be new products, features, loyalty or cross-sell. You'll build the business case, test it and tell us whether it's worth pursuing.
You'll work out what brings customers back. That means understanding how customer value grows over time and what we can do to grow it.
You'll help shape decisions. You'll present clear recommendations to teams and management, helping them understand the opportunity, the trade-offs and what we should do next.
Analysis in an AI-native company
AI isn't a side tool here. It's built into how we work across engineering, analytics, operations and product, and our tech team has built an AI-connected data and code environment on frontier models.
For an analyst, that means you can go further and faster than before. You can write queries, explore data and test hypotheses with tools like Claude at your side. It also means more answers that sound confident and might be wrong.
Part of this role is knowing the difference. We want someone who uses AI to go deeper, and who still questions the data, the assumptions and the AI-generated answer before drawing a conclusion.
The people
You'll work closely with people who enjoy getting into a problem and figuring out what to do about it. They're generous with what they know, quick to laugh and happy to change their minds when they learn something new.
You'll have room to take initiative and people to think things through with. Some ideas will work, others won't. We try things, learn from the results and use that to make the next decision better.
This sounds like you if…
You have an MSc in engineering, business, finance or a similar quantitative field.
You have experience in product, growth or business analytics, ideally in a consumer business. You write strong SQL, and you know how to design an A/B test and how to tell when one is lying to you.
You can take an open question all the way to a clear recommendation. You connect product metrics to what actually happens for customers and to what it's worth for the business.
You're hungry and curious, and you want to own real problems rather than answer someone else's tickets.
We care more about what you can do, your judgment and your drive than a specific number of years. Experience in fintech or consumer lending is a plus, and so is Swedish, Finnish or German. Fluent English is required.
More than anything, you can tell us about an analysis that changed what a company did. Not just what you found, but what happened because of it.
A few practical notes
You’ll be based at our office on Drottninggatan 92 in Stockholm. We work from the office because we value the collaboration, shared learning and team spirit that come from spending time together.
We interview on a rolling basis and would love for you to join us as soon as possible. EU work authorisation is required.
Want to see your analysis turn into real improvements for our customers? We’d love to hear from you.

About Multiply & VisFlow
Multiply is a technology-driven end-to-end solution provider operating at the intersection of advanced software development, system engineering and data-driven platforms. Together with VisFlow — our proprietary product for structured, visual and traceable technical knowledge — we help organizations build, operate and continuously evolve complex systems within security-critical and data-intensive domains.
VisFlow transforms complex technical processes, system flows and operational knowledge into clear, visual and interconnected representations. The platform enables teams to understand, manage and scale advanced systems throughout their entire lifecycle — from development and deployment to operations and continuous improvement.

The Opportunity
We are now looking for experienced engineers within systems engineering, hardware integration, test infrastructure, lab environments, system integration, verification and qualification for advanced technical assignments in complex and security-critical environments.
You may work in the development of next-generation defence, electronic warfare, communication or other advanced technical systems, where prototypes, integration environments, reference systems and verification activities play a central role in bringing complex solutions from concept to qualified product.
These roles are suited for engineers who enjoy working close to the technology, combining structured engineering methods with hands-on problem-solving in multidisciplinary environments.

Current Focus Areas
We are currently looking for experienced specialists within one or more of the following areas:

1. HW Systems Engineering
As a HW Systems Engineer, you may be part of a subsystem team responsible for developing core components of advanced technical systems. Your focus will be systems engineering activities related to hardware integration, testing, verification and qualification.
You will work closely with design, test and system stakeholders, ensuring that insights from prototype testing and integration activities are fed back into design decisions, system requirements and verification plans.
Typical responsibilities may include:
Performing systems engineering activities, including requirements updates and test case definition
Supporting hardware prototype integration and hands-on testing
Troubleshooting hardware issues during integration and test phases
Capturing test results and technical feedback to refine design and system requirements
Supporting formal hardware verification and qualification activities
Collaborating with internal teams, suppliers and external stakeholders
Contributing to structured documentation, traceability and lifecycle governance

2. Test & Lab Infrastructure Engineering
As a Test & Lab Infrastructure Engineer, you will play a central role in enabling system integration and verification of complex technical solutions by establishing, developing and maintaining modern test environments and lab infrastructure.
You will be responsible for ensuring that development, integration and verification activities can be carried out efficiently, structurally and with high quality.
Typical responsibilities may include:
Establishing, developing and maintaining lab environments and reference systems
Designing and implementing modular test solutions, integration rigs and test equipment
Supporting planning, preparation and execution of system integration and verification activities
Contributing to integration, verification and validation strategies
Ensuring strong configuration management, structure and traceability in test environments
Participating in integration, troubleshooting and technical problem-solving when needed
Developing methods, ways of working and technical solutions within test and verification
Collaborating with development teams, delivery projects and other technical functions

Your Profile
We are looking for driven, structured and technically strong engineers who enjoy working in complex, multidisciplinary environments. You are comfortable combining strategic systems thinking with practical, hands-on engineering work.
You may have experience from defence, aerospace, rail, radio communications, med-tech, telecom, automotive, industrial systems or other sectors with high demands on robustness, reliability, traceability and quality.
You bring several of the following:
MSc / Civil Engineering degree in Electronics, Engineering Physics, Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering or a related field
Several years of experience within systems engineering, test, verification, system integration or hardware-focused product development
Experience with requirements management and systems engineering processes
Experience with hardware integration, testing or verification
Experience establishing, developing or maintaining lab environments, reference systems or test infrastructure
Good understanding of system design and system integration processes
Ability to work in both structured engineering processes and hands-on technical environments
Strong communication and collaboration skills
Professional proficiency in Swedish and English

Meriting Experience
It is an advantage if you have experience from one or more of the following areas:
RF and microwave technologies
Hardware-near systems
Communication and network solutions
Defence, aerospace or other security-critical systems
EMC, environmental testing or system qualification
Configuration management in complex system environments
Formal verification and validation
Technical leadership or coordination of technical teams
Prototype development, integration rigs or advanced test equipment
Requirements tools, test management tools or lifecycle management platforms

What Multiply Offers
At Multiply, you become part of an end-to-end provider where deep technical expertise, systems thinking and long-term value creation are central.
We offer:
An inclusive workplace where diversity and respect are core values
Projects that contribute to a sustainable and secure society
Flexible working conditions within meaningful, high-impact assignments
Access to strong professional networks and experienced industry role models
Continuous feedback and support to help you grow in your career
Opportunities to work with advanced systems where technical depth, structure and engineering rigor truly matter

Security Requirements
Some assignments may require that you undergo and are approved in accordance with applicable security protection regulations.

Vill du kombinera ditt teknikintresse med din förmåga att skriva tydligt och pedagogiskt? Hos Saab Dynamics i Boden får du skapa dokumentation som hjälper människor att använda och underhålla avancerade system på ett säkert och effektivt sätt.
Vi söker dig som är nyfiken på hur teknik fungerar och som tycker om att göra komplex information begriplig. Du kan vara en erfaren teknikinformatör eller ha en annan relevant bakgrund och vilja utvecklas inom teknisk dokumentation.
 
Din roll
Du tar fram teknisk dokumentation för digitala ledningsstödsystem som används av Försvarsmakten. Systemen omfattar bland annat datorer, nätverk och radio- och kommunikationsutrustning på olika typer av fordon, båtar och soldatsystem.
Din uppgift är att omvandla tekniskt underlag och kunskap från våra experter till tydliga manualer och instruktioner. Dokumentationen hjälper operatörer och tekniker att förstå, använda och underhålla systemen – och är en viktig del av den lösning vi levererar till kunden.
Du arbetar nära systemingenjörer, konstruktörer, projektledare, produktledare och användare. Du driver dina egna uppgifter och är samtidigt en del av ett team där samarbete och kunskapsdelning är viktiga delar av vardagen.
 
Det här kommer du att arbeta med
Samla in och analysera tekniskt underlag i dialog med sakkunniga.
Strukturera och skriva användarmanualer, instruktioner och underhållsdokumentation.
Granska och kvalitetssäkra innehåll tillsammans med tekniska experter.
Anpassa informationen efter användarnas behov och förkunskaper.
Uppdatera dokumentationen när systemen utvecklas eller förändras.
Bidra till att förbättra våra arbetssätt, metoder och dokumentationsprocesser.

Vi producerar dokumentation på svenska och engelska i en XML-baserad miljö enligt S1000D, en internationell specifikation för strukturerad teknisk dokumentation.
 
Det här får du möjlighet till
Hos oss arbetar du nära både tekniken och människorna som kan den. Du får fördjupa din tekniska förståelse, utveckla din kompetens inom teknikinformation och vara med och påverka hur vi arbetar med dokumentation.
Framför allt får du skapa information som fyller en konkret funktion: att ge användarna rätt förutsättningar att lösa sina uppgifter. Ditt arbete bidrar till Saabs uppdrag att skapa trygghet för människor och samhällen – Keeping People and Society Safe.
 
Din profil
Du har ett teknikintresse och en god förmåga att sätta dig in i hur produkter och system fungerar. Du skriver tydligt och strukturerat och tycker om att förklara sådant som andra kan uppleva som komplicerat.
Din bakgrund kan exempelvis vara inom teknisk dokumentation, ingenjörsarbete, teknisk utbildning, support eller service och underhåll. Du kan ha en relevant utbildning eller ha byggt upp motsvarande kunskaper genom arbete.
För att lyckas i rollen behöver du
Kunna uttrycka dig mycket väl på svenska och engelska, i både tal och skrift.
Kunna analysera och strukturera teknisk information.
Arbeta noggrant och vilja säkerställa att informationen är korrekt och användbar.
Trivas med att samarbeta och ställa frågor till personer med olika kompetenser.

Du behöver inte kunna våra system från början. Däremot vill vi att du är nyfiken, tar ansvar för dina uppgifter och vill lära dig mer.
Erfarenheter som är meriterande
Det är ett plus om du har arbetat med något av följande, men det är inte ett krav:
Teknisk dokumentation, exempelvis användarmanualer eller underhållsinstruktioner.
S1000D eller Simplified Technical English, STE.
XML-baserade publiceringsmiljöer eller innehållshanteringssystem, CMS, exempelvis UPTIME.
Teknisk illustration eller bildbearbetning i Adobe Illustrator eller Photoshop.
Försvarsmakten, FMV eller dokumentation i verksamheter med höga krav på kvalitet och spårbarhet.

Vi välkomnar både dig som är i början av karriären och dig som har flera års relevant erfarenhet.
Placering och resor
Tjänsten är placerad i Boden. Resor förekommer i arbetet.
 
Befattningen kräver
Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassning kan, i förekommande fall, krav på visst medborgarskap förekomma.
 
Ansökan
Saab Dynamics har valt att samarbeta med AxÖ Consulting för denna rekrytering. Har du frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta rekryterande chef Per Nyqvist, Saab Dynamics, 073 – 446 86 38 eller rekryteringskonsult Maria Josefsson, AxÖ Consulting, 070 – 842 23 35.
Urvalsprocessen sker löpande och tjänsterna kan komma att tillsättas före ansökningstidens utgång, så ansök gärna så snart som möjligt. Sista ansökningsdag 25 november.
Ansökan endast via länk intill.
Varmt välkommen med din ansökan – här får du möjlighet att göra skillnad.
 
Vad du blir en del av
Bakom våra innovationer finns alla de som har gjort det möjligt. Modiga pionjärer och kluriga tänkare. Vardagshjältar och kreativa problemlösare. De som delar djup kunskap och de som utforskar nya områden. Och alla däremellan.
Här har du chansen att påverka och bidra på ditt unika sätt. Allt från att utveckla kod och bygga imponerande försvars- och säkerhetslösningar till att ta en kaffe med en kollega. Varje bidrag räknas. Vi ger dig möjlighet att anta utmaningar och skapa smarta innovationer. I vår vänliga och tekniksmarta värld finns plats för dig att växa. Vi finns här för att tillsammans skapa trygghet för människor och samhällen.

jobs.occupation: Senior R&D Engineer – Alloy Design and Materials Performance
jobs.description:
Advancing specialty steel through research and innovation 
From metallurgical research to real-world applicationsDeveloping specialty steel for demanding applications requires a deep understanding of materials, a curiosity to investigate complex problems and the ability to turn scientific findings into practical solutions. At Ovako, this also means working with customers to understand their challenges and exploring how steel can help them develop new products, improve performance and bring new ideas to life. 
As a leading European producer of specialty steel, Ovako combines more than 300 years of industrial expertise with modern technology and a strong commitment to sustainability. As part of Nippon Steel, the company also benefits from an international network of metallurgical knowledge. 
Ovako is looking for a Senior R&D Engineer with expertise in alloy design and materials performance to strengthen its R&D organisation in Hofors, Sweden. 
This role offers the opportunity to combine advanced metallurgical research with customer-driven industrial development. You will investigate how steel composition and processing influence material properties, develop new alloy concepts and tackle complex challenges arising from real applications. Working closely with customers and sales, you will help translate specific performance requirements into material solutions, gaining insight into a range of industries and seeing how your research contributes to customers’ development journeys. 
About the roleAs a Senior R&D Engineer, you will drive research activities in alloy design, steel development and materials performance, combining computational modelling, experimental investigations and collaboration with external research partners. 
Approximately 60% of your time will be dedicated to customer projects. You will investigate material behaviour, assess application requirements and develop steel solutions to meet demanding performance needs. The challenges will vary across applications and industries, giving you the opportunity to apply your scientific expertise to a broad range of practical problems. You will also support product development at Ovako’s production mills, helping connect customer requirements, material performance and industrial processes. 
Collaboration with universities and research institutes is an important part of the role, alongside participation in nationally and internationally funded research projects. You will have opportunities to expand your technical network through research partnerships, conferences and occasional travel to research institutes and other Ovako sites in Europe. 
Your responsibilities 
Developing new steel grades and alloy concepts, from composition to processing route 
Computational alloy design using Thermo-Calc and related tools 
Planning and evaluating corrosion testing data and hydrogen embrittlement investigations 
Driving nationally and internationally funded research projects and consortia 
Collaborating with universities and institutes, including supervision of students 
Supporting sales and customers with qualified answers on material behaviour and selection 
Identifying new research directions that strengthen Ovako's product portfolio and long-term competitiveness 

The position is placed in Hofors, Sweden, with possibilities to work 2 days a week from home.  
Your profileYou are a scientifically driven metallurgist or materials scientist who enjoys exploring the mechanisms behind material behaviour and applying research to complex industrial challenges. You are motivated by understanding why materials behave the way they do and using that knowledge to develop solutions to problems without obvious answers. 
We are looking for someone with: 
A PhD in metallurgy or materials science, with a strong focus on steels and metallic materials. 
At least three years of research experience after your PhD, gained at a university, company R&D centre or research institute. 
Documented expertise in steel alloy design, including hands-on experience with Thermo-Calc. 
Excellent communication skills in English and the ability to explain complex technical findings to different audiences, including customers. 

You should also have experience in nationally or internationally funded research collaborations. 
Meritorious experience:Experience from research or development projects related to corrosion of metallic materials and hydrogen embrittlement of steels is considered an advantage, as these topics represent important current and future challenges within several of Ovako’s research collaborations and customer-driven development projects. 
Who are you?You are curious, analytical and persistent in your approach to research. You enjoy challenging established assumptions, investigating mechanisms and building the evidence needed to understand complex materials problems. 
You combine scientific rigour with a collaborative mindset. You communicate clearly, share knowledge and work effectively with colleagues, customers, production teams and external research partners. 
Ovako's core values are Innovative, Skilled and Responsible. The company looks for people who demonstrate these values through their expertise, curiosity and commitment to continuous improvement. 
Why Ovako?At Ovako, you will work with advanced specialty steel in an environment where scientific research meets real industrial challenges. You will collaborate with experienced specialists, customers, universities and research institutes, with opportunities to deepen your expertise and contribute to the development of future steel solutions. 
As part of Nippon Steel, you will also benefit from an international network of metallurgical knowledge and research collaboration.

The department's activities are conducted at two main locations: Natrium on Medicinaregatan 7B in Gothenburg, and the Kristineberg Marine Research Station in Fiskebäckskil. The current position is located at the premises in Gothenburg, which is where Herbarium GB is situated. The latter hosts more than one million specimens from around the world (~60% imaged; ~28% with digitized metadata) and forms part of a global network of almost 4,000 herbaria.
Subject area 
Botany, specializing in vascular plant systematics.
Subject area description 
Vascular plant systematics is the scientific study of the diversity, evolutionary relationships, and taxonomy of vascular plants. In the 21st century, systematics is a highly integrative discipline, one that engages a diversity of data types and methodologies, and has strong connections to evolutionary biology, ecology, and conservation biology. For this position we seek a plant systematist having competence in the tools of modern systematics, a strong interest in natural history collections, and whose research makes first-hand use of material housed in such collections.
 
Duties 
This associate senior lectureship initially comprises 60% research and teaching in botany and 40% curation of the vascular plant collections at Herbarium GB. The curation component comprises contribution to strategic development of the collections, basic curation, and curation-related research.
Teaching and research tasks include:
Development of and engagement with a sustained, substantive, and productive research program focusing on vascular plants. A significant component of the research should be collections-based, making use of herbarium material.
Building and leading a research group, including applying for external research funding and publishing in high-quality scientific journals.
Teaching topics in plant taxonomy, systematics, and related subjects at undergraduate and graduate levels. This includes lecturing, coordination of practical exercises, course leadership, and project supervision.
Supervising doctoral students.
Participation in the development and renewal of teaching, in both content and form.
Development of collaborations with other research groups at University of Gothenburg and with researchers at other institutions. The department is especially keen to strengthen its collaboration with the Gothenburg Botanical Garden, with respect to research, teaching, and collection management.
Participation in and development of societal collaboration projects.

Curation tasks include:
Participation in the development of strategic goals and drafting of grant applications for Herbarium GB.
Curation and development of the vascular plant collections in Herbarium GB.
Execution and publication of research relating to or arising from curation activities.
Promoting integration of Herbarium GB into university- and botanic garden-based teaching, research, and community activities.
Support of digitization and database cataloguing in line with international standards for specimen data.
Support of visiting researchers and promoting collaboration with national and international institutions.

 
Eligibility 
Eligibility for employment as an associate senior lecturer is regulated by the Higher Education Ordinance and the University of Gothenburg's employment regulations.
To be eligible for appointment as an associate senior lecturer, the applicant must have been awarded a PhD or has the corresponding research expertise. Primary consideration should be given to a person who has been awarded a PhD or achieved the equivalent expertise within seven years of the deadline for application for employment as an associate senior lecturer. However, a person who has been awarded a PhD or achieved equivalent expertise at an earlier date may also be considered if there are exceptional circumstances. Exceptional circumstances are sick leave, parental leave, or other similar circumstances. 
Ability to teach in English is a requirement.
Assessment criteria 
The assessment criteria for appointment as associate senior lecturer are governed by the Higher Education Ordinance and the Appointments Procedure for Teachers at the University of Gothenburg. We seek candidates who have demonstrated the ability to independently initiate, develop, and conduct high-quality research within the subject area of the position. For appointment as an associate senior lecturer at the Faculty of Science and Technology, academic and teaching qualifications must be adequate in relation to the subject content and job description of the advertised position.
For this position, emphasis is placed on research qualifications and expertise, particularly in herbarium specimen-based research, with curation skills considered to be of similar importance. The assessment categories of collaboration with the wider community and management and administrative expertise are considered advantageous.
The assessment of research and curation skills includes
Proficiency in vascular plant systematics, taxonomy, and nomenclature, as evidenced by publications and participation in scientific conferences.
Experience of herbarium curation and/or collections-based taxonomic research.
Advanced knowledge of modern techniques in taxonomy and systematics, including phylogenetic and phylogenomic tools.
A clear vision of the future role and operation of herbaria, and thoughts on the priority actions required to realize that vision.
Experience of herbarium digitization, georeferencing, and/or database development.
Knowledge of the Northern Eurasian and/or Eurasian floras, specifically floristics and regional plant identification.

Personal qualities such as initiative, organization skills, pedagogical insight, and communication skills will also be taken into consideration..

The School of Medical Sciences at Örebro University is seeking a postdoctoral researcher in Biomedicine (Molecular Virology and mRNA Vaccine Development) for a fixed-term appointment.
Subject area
The subject area for this position is Biomedicine.
Background
The School of Medical Sciences at Örebro University is seeking a postdoctoral researcher to join the Cellular and Molecular Virology research group.
The position is part of the research project "Development of novel mRNA-based TBE vaccines", funded by the Knowledge Foundation (KK-stiftelsen). The project focuses on the development and evaluation of novel mRNA-based vaccines against tick-borne encephalitis virus (TBEV).
The research builds on extensive expertise in the molecular biology of tick-borne flaviviruses, viral reverse genetics, virus–host interactions and vaccine development. The project is conducted in close collaboration with academic and industrial partners.
Duties and responsibilities
The appointment as a postdoctoral researcher is intended to enable persons who have recently been awarded their doctoral degree to consolidate and further develop their research skills.
The successful candidate will conduct experimental research focusing on the molecular biology of tick-borne flaviviruses and the development of novel mRNA-based vaccines against tick-borne encephalitis virus (TBEV).
The work will include molecular cloning, viral reverse genetics, infectious cDNA clones, site-directed mutagenesis, and the generation and characterization of recombinant flaviviruses. Particular emphasis will be placed on investigating viral replication, virus–host interactions, and the molecular determinants of viral pathogenicity.
The researcher will also contribute to the design and evaluation of vaccine candidates using cell-based assays, in vivo animal models, neutralization assays, and relevant immunological methods. The project will be conducted in close collaboration with other researchers and industrial partners. The position also involves analysis of experimental data, preparation of scientific publications, and presentation of research findings.
Qualifications
To be eligible for appointment as a postdoctoral researcher, applicants must hold a doctoral degree, or an equivalent foreign degree, in a subject relevant to the position, such as molecular virology, virology, molecular biology or biomedicine.
Applicants who are in the final stages of their doctoral studies and expect to complete their PhD before the employment decision are also encouraged to apply. The doctoral degree must be completed no later than the time of the employment decision.
Priority will be given to applicants who have obtained their doctoral degree no more than three years before the application deadline, in accordance with the applicable postdoctoral employment agreement. Exceptions may apply under special circumstances.
The applicant may not previously have held a position as a postdoctoral researcher for more than one year in the same subject and at the same higher education institution. The position is for a term of at least 2 years initially but may be extended for a further 1 year. If the person during the period of employment has been on parental leave, the period of employment is to be extended by the corresponding number of days. The period of employment may also be extended in the event of absence due to illness.

To see the job advertisement in its entirety, visit https://www.oru.se/english/career/available-positions/job/?jid=20260286.

The position is a full-time (100%) fixed-term appointment for two years, preferably starting in January 2027. The appointment may be extended for up to one additional year, if required to fulfil the purpose of the appointment, subject to available funding and applicable regulations.
